entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding, you're speaking with David at VeloFit. How can I help you today?
Hi, I need to start a return for my VeloBand.
I can certainly look into that for you. To pull up your account, could I get your name and order number?
Maria Garcia, order number is VF607-9912. Just tell me yes or no, can I return it?
Okay, one moment, Maria... I have your order right here. I see the VeloBand GPS Tracker, delivered 41 days ago. To make sure I understand correctly, is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
Preference. To be honest, it was an impulse buy. I've changed my mind and I just don't use it.
I understand. Let me just confirm the return eligibility based on the delivery date. Please hold.
Okay, thanks for waiting. I've checked the policy, and since you're within the 90-day return window, I can absolutely approve this return for a full refund.
Oh. Great. What's the next step?

I've just generated a prepaid shipping label and sent it to the email address on your account. Just pack the VeloBand in its original box, attach the label, and drop it off. Once we receive it, you'll see the refund in 3 to 5 business days.
Got it. Thanks for your help. Bye.
You're very welcome, Maria! Thank you for calling VeloFit and have a great day.
